name: video-model-unified-pricing
title: 视频模型按档位统一定价
description: Video catalog USD standard prices per duration/resolution/audio tier, persisted pricing factors, previews and explicit recalculation.
creator: codex
notes: Implementation completed after user approval. Automatic verification and environment limitations are recorded in verification.md. TEST browser/manual checks remain unexecuted. No staging, commit, deployment or production config writes.

mobile_performance.reason: Admin-only local calculation and optional operator reference fields. No Android/iOS page changes, user API calls, generation changes or quote algorithm changes. Mobile P95 is inapplicable; no samples or fabricated zero baselines. Verify Admin behavior and published matrix compatibility after release.

scope: Video model catalog pricing references and existing draft/publication flow
integration_points: Reuse routes/admin-supabase-proxy.ts clientFetch(admin.supabase_proxy) and its 30-second timeout
Reuse platform/observability/http.ts HTTP terminal events and existing admin publication audit; local validation uses UI feedback
failure_paths: Invalid factors or out-of-range results are rejected locally without requests; preserve catalog and manual prices
Permission rejection, conflict, network failure and timeout retain existing transport/HTTP outcomes; read authoritative state before retrying unknown writes
Missing tier blocks the entire batch; no partial price updates
logging_integration.correlation: Reuse request ALS request_id/trace_id/span_id and existing admin release audit linkage; no new browser telemetry requests.
logging_integration.redaction: Allow only request correlation, status, timing and safe error codes. Never log tokens, sessions, full catalog, standard-price dictionaries or request/response bodies. Existing raw errors use the { err } safe projection.
logging_integration.alerting: Reuse existing HTTP/upstream levels and alert rules, disabled by default. No new alert rules; delivery failure must not affect config operations.
verification: Inspect existing proxy and observed-fetch success/rejection/timeout coverage; run existing Admin/CLI tests and all consumer typechecks
Confirm invalid local input makes no request and preserves the catalog; report any unexecuted remote log verification explicitly
